origin: EVO Racing Team was born from the shared passion of a group of friends in São Paulo, Brazil, in the late 1990s. Led by engineering student Ricardo Silva, they started by modifying and racing old Volkswagens in local amateur events. Their initial 'workshop' was Ricardo's garage, and funding came from pooling their meager savings and relying heavily on borrowed tools and discarded parts. A pivotal moment arrived when they managed a surprise podium finish at a regional endurance race, sparking a wave of local enthusiasm and attracting a small sponsorship from a neighborhood auto parts store.
philosophy: EVO Racing's philosophy is rooted in resourcefulness and a relentless pursuit of improvement. They believe in maximizing the potential of limited resources through meticulous preparation, innovative solutions crafted from readily available materials, and a strong team spirit. Car development is approached pragmatically, focusing on reliability and extracting every ounce of performance from existing components rather than chasing expensive upgrades. Their team culture emphasizes collaboration, mutual support, and a never-say-die attitude.
achievements: Podium finish at the 2003 São Paulo Regional Endurance Race
Multiple class wins in the Brazilian Amateur Touring Car Championship (various years)
Development of an innovative suspension system using locally sourced materials (2010)
Consistent top-10 finishes in the Brazilian Stock Car Light series (early 2010s)

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Silva
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo, a trained engineer, is the heart and soul of EVO Racing. He's known for his hands-on approach, technical expertise, and ability to inspire his team despite limited resources.

keyFigures.name: Isabela Costa
keyFigures.description: Isabela is a master of improvisation and a wizard with engines. Her ability to diagnose and fix problems under pressure is legendary within the team.

keyFigures.name: Paulo Almeida
keyFigures.description: Paulo is a talented driver known for his aggressive driving style and car control. He has been with the team since its early days.

headquarters: EVO Racing's headquarters is a modest workshop located on the outskirts of São Paulo. The facilities are basic, consisting of a garage, a small office, and a storage area filled with spare parts.
fanBase: EVO Racing's fanbase is small but fiercely loyal, primarily consisting of local residents and motorsports enthusiasts who admire their underdog spirit and their commitment to Brazilian racing.
